title: eGramSwaraj elected representatives
description: One row per person in a GP's member response (ElectedMemberRepresent.do, level=V), in response order. Current term only; no reservation, caste or election year.

fields.name: gp_code
fields.description: Gram panchayat LGD local-body code; joins to gps.gp_code.

fields.name: member_index
fields.description: 0-based position of the person in the GP's member response.

fields.name: elected_name
fields.description: electedname exactly as printed, including stray whitespace and placeholder entries.

fields.name: designation_class
fields.description: head: the GP's elected chief (Sarpanch, Mukhiya, Pradhan, President...). ward_member: a ward-elected GP member, including deputies who hold a ward. other: offices of other bodies (e.g. Bihar's Gram Kachahari), staff, co-opted members. Mapping per state is DESIGNATION_CLASS in bin/build_er.py.

fields.name: ward_name
fields.description: wardName exactly as printed; null for most heads.

fields.name: ward_no
fields.description: Ward number parsed from ward_name when it is an explicit ward number ('Ward No. 5', 'Ward-5', '5', 'Five', 'Wimc no.5', '5 No. Ward'); null otherwise (place names, village segments).

fields.name: gender
fields.description: gender exactly as the site codes it (N/A on one member).
